title: A system of sites compatible up to coherent isomorphism can be replaced by a strict one
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set (a nonempty preordered set in which any two elements have a common upper bound). Suppose given: for each $i\in I$ a site $\mathcal C_i$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] all of whose coverings have finite index sets; for $i\le i'$ a continuous functor $u_{i'i}:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_{i'}$ defining a morphism of sites $\mathcal C_{i'}\to\mathcal C_i$, with $u_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$; for $i\le i'\le i''$ a natural isomorphism $\gamma_{i''i'i}:u_{i''i'}\circ u_{i'i}\Rightarrow u_{i''i}$, the identity when $i'=i$ or $i''=i'$, satisfying the cocycle condition $\gamma_{i'''i'i}\circ(\gamma_{i'''i''i'}u_{i'i})=\gamma_{i'''i''i}\circ(u_{i'''i''}\gamma_{i''i'i})$ (as natural transformations $u_{i'''i''}u_{i''i'}u_{i'i}\Rightarrow u_{i'''i}$) for $i\le i'\le i''\le i'''$; a category $\mathcal D$ with functors $v_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal D$ and natural isomorphisms $\delta_{i'i}:v_{i'}\circ u_{i'i}\Rightarrow v_i$, $\delta_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$, with $\delta_{i''i}\circ(v_{i''}\gamma_{i''i'i})=\delta_{i'i}\circ(\delta_{i''i'}u_{i'i})$. Then there are sites $\mathcal C'_i$ with finite coverings and functors $e_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C'_i$ which are equivalences of categories such that a family of morphisms of $\mathcal C_i$ with common target is a covering if and only if its image under $e_i$ is one, and every covering of $\mathcal C'_i$ is isomorphic (by isomorphisms of the members over an isomorphism of the targets) to the image of a covering of $\mathcal C_i$; continuous functors $u'_{i'i}:\mathcal C'_i\to\mathcal C'_{i'}$ ($i\le i'$) defining morphisms of sites $\mathcal C'_{i'}\to\mathcal C'_i$, with $u'_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $u'_{i''i'}\circ u'_{i'i}=u'_{i''i}$ (equality of functors), and natural isomorphisms $\theta_{i'i}:u'_{i'i}\circ e_i\Rightarrow e_{i'}\circ u_{i'i}$; and functors $v'_i:\mathcal C'_i\to\mathcal D$ with $v'_{i'}\circ u'_{i'i}=v'_i$ and $v'_i\circ e_i=v_i$ (equalities of functors) such that $v'_{i'}\theta_{i'i}=\delta_{i'i}^{-1}$ as natural transformations $v_i=v'_{i'}u'_{i'i}e_i\Rightarrow v'_{i'}e_{i'}u_{i'i}=v_{i'}u_{i'i}$. In particular $(\mathcal C'_i,u'_{i'i})$, indexed by the cofiltered category $I^{\mathrm{op}}$ (one arrow $i'\to i$ for each $i\le i'$), is a system of sites as in Situation 0A34 of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites], and the $v'_i$ induce a functor $V:\varinjlim_i\mathcal C'_i\to\mathcal D$ on the colimit category with $V\circ c_i=v'_i$ for the canonical functors $c_i:\mathcal C'_i\to\varinjlim\mathcal C'_i$. (The construction, Stacks Categories 004A on the fibres: objects of $\mathcal C'_i$ are pairs $(j,V)$ with $j\le i$ and $V\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C_j)$, $\operatorname{Hom}((j,V),(k,W))=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C_i}(u_{ij}V,u_{ik}W)$ with the composition of $\mathcal C_i$; $u'_{i'i}(j,V)=(j,V)$, $u'_{i'i}(f)=\gamma_{i'ik}(W)\circ u_{i'i}(f)\circ\gamma_{i'ij}(V)^{-1}$; $e_i(V)=(i,V)$, $e_i(f)=f$; $v'_i(j,V)=v_j(V)$, $v'_i(f)=\delta_{ik}(W)\circ v_i(f)\circ\delta_{ij}(V)^{-1}$.)
